faqs.q: What is DIN 5683 Long Link Chain used for?
faqs.a: DIN 5683 Long Link Chain for tension, lashing and fixing duty. Built to the DIN 5683 pattern. It is not lifting chain. It is listed in 10 sizes, 13 mm (4/8) to 39 mm (1″9/16).

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for DIN 5683 Long Link Chain, such as IH-LR-CH-D5683LLC-13MM?
faqs.a: DIN 5683 Long Link Chain part numbers begin with IH-LR-CH-D5683LLC and end in a size code: IH-LR-CH-D5683LLC-13MM is the 13 mm (4/8) size and IH-LR-CH-D5683LLC-39MM is the 39 mm (1″9/16) size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does DIN 5683 Long Link Chain come in?
faqs.a: DIN 5683 Long Link Chain is listed in 10 sizes, 13 mm (4/8) to 39 mm (1″9/16), each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-CH-D5683LLC-13MM and IH-LR-CH-D5683LLC-39MM. The table includes 13 mm (4/8): minimum breaking load 210 kN, proof load 110 kN and 39 mm (1″9/16): minimum breaking load 950 kN, proof load 190 kN.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of DIN 5683 Long Link Chain?
faqs.a: For DIN 5683 Long Link Chain, select on link size and breaking load for the duty, and use Grade 80 or Grade 100 alloy chain if the chain will lift. A breaking load is a test figure, not a working load.

faqs.q: What is the rated load of DIN 5683 Long Link Chain?
faqs.a: DIN 5683 Long Link Chain is listed with a minimum breaking load 160 to 950 kN. For example, 26 mm (1″): minimum breaking load 400 kN, proof load 80 kN. A breaking load is a test figure, not a working load, so the duty rating for your application is confirmed with us before the order.

faqs.q: What is DIN 5683 Long Link Chain made from, and what finish does it have?
faqs.a: For DIN 5683 Long Link Chain, the material is Alloy steel 20MnSi; the finish is Zinc plated/selfcolor/hot dipped galvanized. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to DIN 5683 Long Link Chain?
faqs.a: DIN 5683 Long Link Chain is listed to DIN 5683. For third-party certification or a witnessed proof test, say so on the RFQ before the order is placed.

faqs.q: What should I use instead of DIN 5683 Long Link Chain for overhead lifting?
faqs.a: For DIN 5683 Long Link Chain, use rated alloy lifting chain with fittings of the same grade, such as [alloy lifting chain](/c/alloy-lifting-chain) in Grade 80 or Grade 100, and tell us the load if you want a component suggested.

faqs.q: How should DIN 5683 Long Link Chain be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Check DIN 5683 Long Link Chain for stretched or opened links, nicks, bent links and corrosion before use, and replace any damaged length. For anything that carries a person-safety load, ask us which rated product to use.

faqs.q: How does DIN 5683 Long Link Chain differ from DIN 763 Long Link Chain?
faqs.a: DIN 5683 Long Link Chain differs from [DIN 763 Long Link Chain](/p/din-763-long-link-chain) in its pattern / standard DIN 5683 against DIN 763; minimum breaking load 160 to 950 kN against 1.25 to 400 kN.

faqs.a: Yes. We ship DIN 5683 Long Link Chain from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep DIN 5683 Long Link Chain in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep DIN 5683 Long Link Chain in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
